verses.en: But Solomon was building his own house thirteen years, and he finished all his house.
verses.sm: E SEFULU ma le tolu o tausaga o fai ai e Solomona lona lava fale, ua ia faauma ona fai o lona fale uma.

verses.en: He built also the house of the forest of Lebanon; the length thereof was an hundred cubits, and the breadth thereof fifty cubits, and the height thereof thirty cubits, upon four rows of cedar pillars, with cedar beams upon the pillars.
verses.sm: Ua ia faia foi le fale o le vao o Lepanona, e tasi le selau o kupita o lona umi, e lima sefulu kupita o lona lautele.e tolu sefulu fei kupita o lona maualuga; ua ia fai ai i luga o atu pou arasi e fa, o laau faalava arasi foi i luga o pou.

verses.en: And it was covered with cedar above upon the beams, that lay on forty five pillars, fifteen in a row.
verses.sm: Ua ufitia foi i arasi i luga o laau faalava, i luga o pou e fagafulu ma le lima, e taisefulu ma le ]lima pou i le atu pou e tasi.

verses.en: And there were windows in three rows, and light was against light in three ranks.
verses.sm: Sa i ai atu faamalama e tolu, ua faafeagai lea faamalama ma lea faamalama i ia atu faamalama e tolu.

verses.en: And all the doors and posts were square, with the windows: and light was against light in three ranks.
verses.sm: O faitotoa uma ma pou ua faatāfafa ia, ua o gatasitasi ma laau faalava, ua faafeagai foi lea faamalama ma lea faamalama i atu faamalama e tolu.

verses.en: And he made a porch of pillars; the length thereof was fifty cubits, and the breadth thereof thirty cubits: and the porch was before them: and the other pillars and the thick beam were before them.
verses.sm: Ua ia faia foi le faapaologa i pou, e lima sefulu kupita o lona umi, e tolu sefulu kupita o lona lautele ; sa i o latou luma le faapaologa, sa i o latou luma foi pou ma le laau faalava.

verses.en: Then he made a porch for the throne where he might judge, even the porch of judgment: and it was covered with cedar from one side of the floor to the other.
verses.sm: Ona faia lea e ia o le faapaologa mo le nofoālii na te fai ai faamasinoga, o le faapaologa lea e faamasino ai; sa tāpapa ai i le arasi, e afua ae i le lotofale i lalo e oo i le fogāfale i luga.

verses.en: And his house where he dwelt had another court within the porch, which was of the like work. Solomon made also an house for Pharaoh's daughter, whom he had taken to wife, like unto this porch.
verses.sm: O lona fale foi sa nofo ai o ia ua i ai le lotoā i tua o le faapaologa, sa faapea foi ona fai. Ua faia foi e Solomona o le fale mo le afafine o Farao, o le ua fai mana avā, e faapei o lena faapaologa.

verses.en: All these were of costly stones, according to the measures of hewed stones, sawed with saws, within and without, even from the foundation unto the coping, and so on the outside toward the great court.
verses.sm: O maa silisili na fai ai uma lava, e pei o le fua o maa talai, ua ilia i ili, o totonu atoa foi ma tna, e amata ae i le faavae, e oo i maa aupitoaluga, atoa ma tuafafo atu, e oo i le lotoā tele.

verses.en: And the foundation was of costly stones, even great stones, stones of ten cubits, and stones of eight cubits.
verses.sm: Ua faia foi le faavae i maa silisili, o maa tetele, o maa taisefulu o kupita, ma maa taivalu o kupita.

verses.en: And above were costly stones, after the measures of hewed stones, and cedars.
verses.sm: Sa i luga foi maa silisili, e pei o le fua o maa talai; sa i ai foi arasi.

verses.en: And the great court round about was with three rows of hewed stones, and a row of cedar beams, both for the inner court of the house of the LORD, and for the porch of the house.
verses.sm: /Sa i le lotoā tele foi na soo ai o le atu maa talai ua sāutuatolu, ma le atu laau faalava o arasi ua talai, mo le lotoā aupito i totonu e pei o le fale o Ieova, atoa ma le faapaologa o le fale.

verses.en: And king Solomon sent and fetched Hiram out of Tyre.
verses.sm: Ua alu atu le feau a le tupu o Solomona, ma ua au mai ia Hiramo mai Turo.

verses.en: He was a widow's son of the tribe of Naphtali, and his father was a man of Tyre, a worker in brass: and he was filled with wisdom, and understanding, and cunning to work all works in brass. And he came to king Solomon, and wrought all his work.
verses.sm: O le tama tane ia a le fafine ua oti lana tane, o lo le itu aiga o Nafatali, a o lona tamā o le tagata Turo ia, o le tufuga fai mea ‘apa memea; sa tumu ia i le poto, ma le mafaufau, ua na iloa e faigaluega uma i mea ‘apa memea. Ua sau o ia i le tnpu o Solomona, ma na faia ana galuega uma.

verses.en: For he cast two pillars of brass, of eighteen cubits high apiece: and a line of twelve cubits did compass either of them about.
verses.sm: Ua faia e ia o pou ‘apa memea e lua, e sefulu ma le valu o kupita o lo ]a maualuga taitasi; ua faataaliolioina foi o lea pou ma lea pou i le fua e sefulu ma le lua ona kupita.

verses.en: And he made two chapiters of molten brass, to set upon the tops of the pillars: the height of the one chapiter was five cubits, and the height of the other chapiter was five cubits:
verses.sm: Ua faia foi e ia o kapetala e lua i ‘apa memea ua tunua e tuu ae ai i pito pou i luga ; e lima kupita le maualuga o le tasi kapetala, e lima kupita foi le maualuga o le isi kapetala.

verses.en: And nets of checker work, and wreaths of chain work, for the chapiters which were upon the top of the pillars; seven for the one chapiter, and seven for the other chapiter.
verses.sm: Ud faia foi e ia o mea faaupega, ma mea faafilifili mo kapetala ua i ai i pito pou i luga ; e fitu mo ie’ tasi kapetala, e fitu foi mo lona lua o kapetala.

verses.en: And he made the pillars, and two rows round about upon the one network, to cover the chapiters that were upon the top, with pomegranates: and so did he for the other chapiter.
verses.sm: Ua ia faia o pou, ma atu rimoni e lua i le mea faaupega e faataaliolio ai, e ufitia ai le tasi kapetala i le pito pou i luga; ua faapea foi o ia i lona lua o kapetala.

verses.en: And the chapiters that were upon the top of the pillars were of lily work in the porch, four cubits.
verses.sm: O kapetala i pito pou i luga ua i ai foi mea e pei o susana e fa kupita i le faapaologa.

verses.en: And the chapiters upon the two pillars had pomegranates also above, over against the belly which was by the network: and the pomegranates were two hundred in rows round about upon the other chapiter.
verses.sm: O kapetala i luga o pou e lua, ua i ai atu rimoni mai luga lava i le mea lautele ua i le mea faaupega ; e tailua selau rimoni i atu rimoni i le tasi kapetala e faataaliolio ai.

verses.en: And he set up the pillars in the porch of the temple: and he set up the right pillar, and called the name thereof Jachin: and he set up the left pillar, and called the name thereof Boaz.
verses.sm: Ua ia faatuina ia pou i le faapaologa o le malumalu ; ua ia faatuina le pou i le itu taumatau, ma ia faaigoaina lona igoa o Iakina; ua ia faatuina le pou i le itu tauagavale ma faaigoaina lona igoa o Poasa.

verses.en: And upon the top of the pillars was lily work: so was the work of the pillars finished.
verses.sm: Ua i ai foi i pito pou i luga o mea e pei o susana. Ua faauma ai ona faia o pou.

verses.en: And he made a molten sea, ten cubits from the one brim to the other: it was round all about, and his height was five cubits: and a line of thirty cubits did compass it round about.
verses.sm: Ua ia faia foi le vai ‘apa memea, e sefulu kupita lona fua, e afua mai i le tasi itu o lona lau, e oo i le isi itu o lona lau ; o le mea faataaliolio lava ; e lima kupita o lona maualuga ; ua faataaliolioina i le. fua e tolu sefulu ona kupita.

verses.en: And under the brim of it round about there were knops compassing it, ten in a cubit, compassing the sea round about: the knops were cast in two rows, when it was cast.
verses.sm: Sa i lalo foi o lona lau o vine vao e faataaliolio ai ua soo ai lava, e taisefulu i kupita ; ua faataaliolioina le vai; ua faia o atu vine vao e lua ina o faia ia.

verses.en: It stood upon twelve oxen, three looking toward the north, and three looking toward the west, and three looking toward the south, and three looking toward the east: and the sea was set above upon them, and all their hinder parts were inward.
verses.sm: Ua faaee ai i luga o povi e sefulu ma le lua; ua faasaga le tolu i le itu i matu, ua faasaga le tolu i sisifo, ua faasaga le tolu i le itu i toga, ua faasaga foi le tolu i sasae ; ua i o latou luga le vai, o latou tua uma foi na i totonu ia.

verses.en: And it was an hand breadth thick, and the brim thereof was wrought like the brim of a cup, with flowers of lilies: it contained two thousand baths.
verses.sm: O lona mafiafia e tusa lea ma le lautele o le alofilima; ua faia foi iona lau e pei o le lau o se ipu, ua fai ai fuga o le susana ; o lona tumu foi e lua afe o paita lea.

verses.en: And he made ten bases of brass; four cubits was the length of one base, and four cubits the breadth thereof, and three cubits the height of it.
verses.sm: Ua faia foi e ia o tuugatanoa ‘apa memea e mulumulu ai e sefulu ; e fa kupita le umi o le tuuga e tasi, e fa kupita foi lona lautele e tolu kupita foi lona maualuga.

verses.en: And the work of the bases was on this manner: they had borders, and the borders were between the ledges:
verses.sm: Ua faapea ona faia o tuugatanoa ua i ai itu,

verses.en: And on the borders that were between the ledges were lions, oxen, and cherubims: and upon the ledges there was a base above: and beneath the lions and oxen were certain additions made of thin work.
verses.sm: sa i ai foi i ia itu o tafatafa. Sa i ai foi i la itu i le va o lato.u tafatafa o leona, ma povi, ma kerupi ; sa i luga foi o tafatafa o le tuuga i luga; sa i lalo foi o leona ma povi o mea fili faatautau.

verses.en: And every base had four brasen wheels, and plates of brass: and the four corners thereof had undersetters: under the laver were undersetters molten, at the side of every addition.
verses.sm: Ua i ai i tuuga taitasi o mea ‘apa memea e faataavalevale a‘i e fa, ma o latou. ‘au ‘apa memea; ua i ai foi i ona tuli e fa o lagolago ; o lagolago ‘apa memea i lalo o le tanoa e mulumulu ai i itu o mea fili taitasi.

verses.en: And the mouth of it within the chapiter and above was a cubit: but the mouth thereof was round after the work of the base, a cubit and an half: and also upon the mouth of it were gravings with their borders, foursquare, not round.
verses.sm: O lona gutu foi i totonu o le kapetala ma ona luga, o le kupita lea ; sa fai faataaliolio lona gutu, na faatatauina i ona fai o le tuugatanoa, o le kupita ma le vaeluagalemu o le kupita ; ua i ai foi i lona gutu o mea ua togitogia, o latou tafatafa foi ua faatāfafa ia, ua le fai faataaliolio.

verses.en: And under the borders were four wheels; and the axletrees of the wheels were joined to the base: and the height of a wheel was a cubit and half a cubit.
verses.sm: Sa i lalo foi o tafatafa o mea e faataavalevale a‘i e fa ; o ‘au foi o mea e faataavalevale a‘i sa i le i\mgā,tanoa ia ; o le kupita ma le vaeluagalemu o le kupita o le maualuga lea o mea e faataavalevale a‘i taitasi.

verses.en: And the work of the wheels was like the work of a chariot wheel: their axletrees, and their naves, and their felloes, and their spokes, were all molten.
verses.sm: Ua faia mea e faataavalevale a‘i e pei ona faia o se mea e faataavale a‘i se kariota; o latou ‘au, ma o latou suluga ‘au, ma o latou maga, ma mea e lio a‘i, o ‘apa memea uma ia.

verses.en: And there were four undersetters to the four corners of one base: and the undersetters were of the very base itself.
verses.sm: Ua i ai lagolago e fa i ona tuli e fa o le tuugāta?2cw e tasi; ua auga faatasi le tuuga ma ona lagolago.

verses.en: And in the top of the base was there a round compass of half a cubit high: and on the top of the base the ledges thereof and the borders thereof were of the same.
verses.sm: Sa i ai i le itu i luga o le tuuga o le mea e lio a‘i ua faataaliolio ai, o le vaeluagalemu o le kupita lona maualuga; ua auga faatasi foi ma le tuuga lava o ona tafatafa, ma ona itu sa i lona itu i luga.

verses.en: For on the plates of the ledges thereof, and on the borders thereof, he graved cherubims, lions, and palm trees, according to the proportion of every one, and additions round about.
verses.sm: Auā ua ia togitogiina i papa o latou tafatafa, ma o latou itu, o kerupi, ma leona, ma pama, ua faatatauina i mea ua aunoa e taitasi, ma mea fili e faataaliolio ai.

verses.en: After this manner he made the ten bases: all of them had one casting, one measure, and one size.
verses.sm: Ua faapea ona faia e ia o ia tuugatanoa e sefulu ; ua gatasi ona faia, ma ona fuatia, ma ona tino mai o i latou uma.

verses.en: Then made he ten lavers of brass: one laver contained forty baths: and every laver was four cubits: and upon every one of the ten bases one laver.
verses.sm: Ua faia foi e ia o tanoa ‘apa memea e sefulu e mulumulu ai; e fagafulu o paita o le tumu o le tanoa e tasi; e taifa kupita o tanoa; o tuuga e sefulu, e taitasi ma lona tanoa i ona luga.

verses.en: And he put five bases on the right side of the house, and five on the left side of the house: and he set the sea on the right side of the house eastward over against the south.
verses.sm: Ua ia tuu tuuga e lima i le itu taumatau o le fale, ma le lima i le itu tauagavale o le fale ; ua ia tuu foi le vai i le itu taumatau o le fale, e faasaga i le itu itoga.

verses.en: And Hiram made the lavers, and the shovels, and the basons. So Hiram made an end of doing all the work that he made king Solomon for the house of the LORD:
verses.sm: Ua faia e Hiramo o tanoa, ma suo, ma ipu ; ua faaumaina foi e Hiramo ona fai o le galuega uma na ia faia mo le tupu o Solomona mo le fale o Ieova;

verses.en: The two pillars, and the two bowls of the chapiters that were on the top of the two pillars; and the two networks, to cover the two bowls of the chapiters which were upon the top of the pillars;
verses.sm: o pou e lua, ma mea lapotopoto mo kapetala i luga o pou e lua; ma mea faaupega e lua e ufiufi a‘i ia mea lapotopoto e lua mo kapetala sa i luga o pou.

verses.en: And four hundred pomegranates for the two networks, even two rows of pomegranates for one network, to cover the two bowls of the chapiters that were upon the pillars;
verses.sm: O rimoni foi e fa galau mo mea faaupega e lua ; o atu rimoni e lua sa i le mea faaupega e tasi e ufiufi a‘i ia mea lapotopoto o kapetala i luga o pou.

verses.en: And the ten bases, and ten lavers on the bases;
verses.sm: O tuugatanoa e sefulu, ma tanoa e sefulu i luga o tuuga.

verses.en: And one sea, and twelve oxen under the sea;
verses.sm: O le vai e tasi, ma povi e sefulu ma le lua i lalo o le vai.

verses.en: And the pots, and the shovels, and the basons: and all these vessels, which Hiram made to king Solomon for the house of the LORD, were of bright brass.
verses.sm: O ulo, ma suo, ma ipu. Ua faia ia mea uma e Hiramo mo le tupu o Solomona mo le fale o Ieova, i ‘apa memea ua faapupulaina.

verses.en: In the plain of Jordan did the king cast them, in the clay ground between Succoth and Zarthan.
verses.sm: Ua faia ia mea e le tupu i le eleele laugatasi o Ioritana, i le eleele omea i le va o Sukota ma Saretana.

verses.en: And Solomon left all the vessels unweighed, because they were exceeding many: neither was the weight of the brass found out.
verses.sm: Ua tuua e Solomona o ia mea uma ua le faitaulia, auā na matuā tele lava; ua le masino lava le fua o le mamafa o ‘apa memea-.

verses.en: And Solomon made all the vessels that pertained unto the house of the LORD: the altar of gold, and the table of gold, whereupon the shewbread was,
verses.sm: Ua faia e Solomona o mea uma o le fale o Ieova; o le fata faitaulaga auro ; ma le laulau auro ua i ona luga le areto e laulauina i luma;

verses.en: And the candlesticks of pure gold, five on the right side, and five on the left, before the oracle, with the flowers, and the lamps, and the tongs of gold,
verses.sm: ma tuugālamepa auro lelei, e lima i le itu taumatau e lima foi i le itu tauagavale, i luma o le mea e fetalai mai ai; ma fua, ma lamepa, ma iofi, o auro ia;

verses.en: And the bowls, and the snuffers, and the basons, and the spoons, and the censers of pure gold; and the hinges of gold, both for the doors of the inner house, the most holy place, and for the doors of the house, to wit, of the temple.
verses.sm: o tanoa foi, ma selelamepa, ma ipu, ma ipu e asu a‘i, ma salefu, o auro lelei ia ; o faamau auro e feafeai mo puipui o le fale aupito i tua, o le mea e sili ona paia lea; atoa ma puipui o le fale, o le malumalu lea.

verses.en: So was ended all the work that king Solomon made for the house of the LORD. And Solomon brought in the things which David his father had dedicated; even the silver, and the gold, and the vessels, did he put among the treasures of the house of the LORD.
verses.sm: Ua uma foi ona fai o le galuega uma na faia e le tupu o Solomona mo le fale o Ieova. Ona au mai lea e Solomona o mea na faasaina e lona tamā o Tavita; o ario, ma auro, ma ipu; ua ia tuu faatasi foi ma oloa o le fale o leova. O le faaulufalega o le malumalu.
